description: Defines the data structure for a Live Activity widget in an iOS app using ActivityKit. It specifies attributes and content state for the activity, including preview states for debugging.

classes.name: OpenClawActivityAttributes
classes.description: Struct conforming to ActivityAttributes protocol, representing shared attributes for a Live Activity. Contains an inner struct for content state.

classes.name: OpenClawActivityAttributes.ContentState
classes.description: Inner struct representing the dynamic state of the activity, including status text and boolean flags indicating activity status.

methods.name: preview
methods.description: Static preview instance for debugging in development environments.
